title: Nine Hundred Thousand Candles

mood.label: Uneasy calm
mood.summary: Uneasy calm (40): drone debris killed two in Kuwait, a Cairo tanker fire killed 31, storms blacked out 900,000 Americans and a tanker capsized off Ibiza. Steadier notes: Argentina stopped printing money, and a Samarkand centre is sheltering women.

lines: The sky over Kuwait caught what it was thrown,
still the pieces found two men walking home.
In Cairo a tanker burned the street to the bone,
and the driver sits in a room of his own.
Off Ibiza a hull rolled over slow,
diesel in the water where the swimmers go.
Buenos Aires put the printing press to bed,
and in Samarkand a door stayed open instead.
Nine hundred thousand candles lit tonight,
the storm took the wires but it can't take the light.
An uneasy calm, a held breath, a hand —
keep one burning till the morning lands.
